hero.headline: The most dependable, cost-effective, and frictionless platform for automating complex AI workflows across any environment.
hero.body: Show free orchestration first, then show the paid layer only where it proves savings, continuity, and interruption recovery.

sections.headline: Free cross-platform orchestration proof
bullets: The same orchestration contract spans CLI, desktop, and mobile surfaces.
App shell downloads remain free to inspect when platform delivery is live.
Local SLM and BYO provider paths remain part of the open-core/free baseline.

sections.headline: Trust boundary and launch honesty
bullets: Public proof is acceptable only when it clearly marks preview posture and current release limits.
Do not claim live payment, live store rollout, or signed-download readiness before those lanes are real.
Keep measurable route and savings evidence attached to every paid-value claim.

trust_rules: Do not present mocked telemetry as live proof.
Do not claim public download or store availability before the release packet says it is live.
Do not claim savings without a measurable route and renewal story.
Do not hide preview posture when the apps are not release-ready.
